projects.title: Once Quartz
projects.summary: A Windows app for sending Telegram view-once and self-destructing photos and videos from your PC.
projects.body:
Telegram lets you send "view once" and self-destructing photos and videos from your phone, but not from your computer. Once Quartz adds that to Windows.

Sign in with your own Telegram account. You can add up to 3 accounts and switch between them in one click, and your login stays only on your computer. Pick a private chat, add photos or videos, choose View once or a 3s, 10s, 30s or 60s timer, and press SEND ONCE. Each file's size is shown before you send.

The interface uses a dark graphite glass design with chrome lettering and a slow animated background. It stays smooth and respects Windows' reduce-animations setting.

Built with Python and an HTML/CSS interface, and packaged as a normal Windows installer.

Works in private chats only. The receiver can still photograph the screen with another device. Unofficial app, not affiliated with Telegram.
